user.title: Connect to the SolarEdge monitoring portal
user.description: Per-optimizer data is only available from the monitoring portal, so this uses the same login as monitoring.solaredge.com. The site ID is shown in the portal's site details.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate integration
reauth_confirm.description: The SolarEdge portal rejected the password for {username}.

error.no_optimizers: The portal did not list any optimizers for this site.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the portal. The inverter uploads optimizer data about every 15 minutes.
data_description.low_output_percent: An optimizer producing less than this share of its string's median power counts as low output.
data_description.min_peer_power: Only compare optimizers when their peers' median power is at least this high, so dawn, dusk and heavy cloud are ignored.
data_description.consecutive_samples: How many new samples in a row must be bad before a problem is reported. Filters out passing shadows.
data_description.stale_after: Report an optimizer as not reporting when it has been silent this long while the rest of the site is producing.
